Miscellaneous
• Soup(a) – vitamised or strained to remove lumps

Stroke nutritional management


Artiﬁcial Nutritional Support
The presence of severe dysphagia and cognitive and complex physical impairments may render oral feeding unsafe or insufﬁcient for
nutritional requirements. If the gastrointestinal tract is functional, the options for delivering enteral nutritional support are either
a ﬁne-bore NGT or a PEG or radiologically inserted gastrostomy.
Decisions concerning choice of route are inﬂuenced by the anticipated duration of dysphagia and beneﬁts versus risks. Impact on
nutritional status, rehabilitation, quality of life, safety, tolerance, ﬂexibility, ease of use
